lines.text: The Book of Moses was read aloud, and the people excluded all of foreign descent after hearing Ammonites and Moabites were barred.
The Levites and singers had gone back to their flocks, so Nehemiah rebuked the officials and stationed them at posts.
Nehemiah rebuked Jews who married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab, and pointed to King Saul's sin.
